entries.title: Fixture violates unique index
entries.root_cause: The harbor_berths fixtures define two records with the same unique berth code, causing PostgreSQL to reject fixture insertion. Correct the duplicate fixture value.

entries.title: Asset precompile cannot resolve stylesheet import
entries.root_cause: The application stylesheet imports a nonexistent trestle_palette partial. Add the missing partial or correct the import.
